title: Using De-MetaST-BLAST for Primer Validation
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ii2ccge

steps.title: Perform Gene Alignment
steps.instruction: Use MEGA to perform an alignment of the gene of interest.

steps.title: Validate Amplicon Variability
steps.instruction: Ensure the predicted amplicon (70-200bp for RT-qPCR) has sufficient variability to distinguish taxonomy via sequencing.

steps.title: Analyze Primer Structures
steps.instruction: Check for G4 complexes and other secondary structures that the primers may form.

steps.title: Verify PCR Stability
steps.instruction: Check for non-specific amplification and thermal stability for PCR protocols.

steps.title: Launch De-MetaST-BLAST
steps.instruction: Open the terminal and navigate to the program directory.

substeps.instruction: Execute: cd ~/Desktop/Sam/De-MetaST-BLAST/ (or the specific directory where the program is located)

steps.title: Input Primer File
steps.instruction: Provide the filename for the primers when prompted by the program.

substeps.instruction: Press Enter to use the default 'Primers.txt' or specify a custom file (e.g., Custom file.txt)
